title: x402-conformance matrix row
description: One project's row in docs/MATRIX.md, from the 'Add or update my row' issue form. Public details only: no emails, no keys, no private data. A row exists only with all four consents.

testnet_endpoint.description: The public testnet paid URL the run queue checks from outside (tier 1): at most eight unpaid requests (GETs, and one HEAD for R16a only with consent.unpaid_head) paced at least 5 s apart, never mainnet

badge.description: Display the badge in our README with attribution to Optitransfer/x402-conformance

hook.description: Free program: the project installs the notify hook so each published release gets a tier-1 external rerun and its tier-2 attestation verified, for six months

unpaid_head.description: Optional: the operator allows one unpaid HEAD request per tier-1 run (R16a). It is the operator's permission the queue passes as --operator-permission (the row's consent issue); without it R16a is left to the self-hosted run

evidence.description: Tier 1: the run queue's external run, committed by tools/row_from_evidence.py

tier.description: Written by the tools, never by the form: external-verified (tier 1, the run queue's external run) or full-suite-self-hosted (tier 2, a verified attestation of the project's own full-suite run)

attestation.description: Tier 2: the verified attestation (tools/attestation.py), signed in the project's own CI with GitHub artifact attestations

release.description: Written by tools/matrix_freshness.py, never by the form: the project's latest release or tag and default-branch commit as of checked_at, and since when the version tested has been behind it.

readme_badge.description: Whether the project's public README links its row or badge, as of checked_at; null when not checked

program_start.description: Free run program: the day the project consented (the hook ticked); queued reruns on new releases run until program_end

program_end.description: Free run program: six months after program_start. After it the row stays listed with its last result, marked stale, and the badge greys out; nothing is deleted

program_notice.description: The day the five-month renewal heads-up issue was opened (written by tools/matrix_freshness.py)
